summary.triangle_quality_note: Q = 4 sqrt(3) area / sum(edge length squared). 1 is equilateral; 0 is degenerate. Shape quality is not surface accuracy.
summary.topology_note: Components are triangles joined through shared edges. Open boundary edges can be intentional portals or measurement limits. These checks do not test self-intersections or certify watertightness or measurement coverage.
summary.fit_note: Area-weighted surface samples; normalized squared Chamfer = half the sum of directional mean squared nearest-neighbour distances. Approximate, not exact point-to-triangle deviation. Reference points are bounded spatial representatives of retained measurements; this is not full-density survey deviation.
summary.smoothing: None; median radius per occupied cell
summary.support_coverage_note: Fraction of measured grid cells used by at least one triangle. This measures measured-support retention; it does not certify that an unmeasured region is complete.
summary.warning: One approximately straight branch; grid vertices are fitted positions. Small gaps are interpolated in one pass only up to the stated local distance. Large gaps and ends stay open. For curved tunnels use Alignment-grid; separate junctions and clean equipment first. Radial medians do not identify services when services dominate a cell.
summary.median_approximation: Exact support counts from every finite retained measurement; median of up to 17 reproducibly sampled measured radii per cell. Cells within that capacity use the exact median. Reservoir priorities use original point IDs, independent of input chunk boundaries. Larger cells use an approximate median.
summary.point_spacing_note: Estimated distance between spatially distributed measured fit-reference points, not full-source point spacing.
